name: ProSE + PeptDeep Entrapment Benchmark
description: Two arms over the same fixture: baseline (ProSE -> Percolator) vs ProSE with PeptDeep MS2+RT prediction rescoring features. Headline metrics: target PSMs and unique target peptides at 1% FDR, wall time, peak RSS. Entrapment PSMs (protein accessions with the configured prefix) are the false-discovery proxy.
note: Fixture-driven: the mzML and target+entrapment FASTA are supplied via environment variables (PROSE_INPUT, PROSE_FASTA); no dataset is vendored yet (pending the minimal entrapment dataset).
